text: Sickness spreads through one of your wandering camps. The shamans argue over the remedy.
Cull the sick before it spreads.
Pay the healers to tend them.
Two clans in one of your hosts have come to blows over an old insult. Blood may answer blood.
Let them settle it in blood.
Pay the blood-price and end it.
A band of displaced kinsfolk has found one of your camps and asks to join the host.
Turn them away, but take their tribute.
